testExtractionStats.note: Counts describe AST declaration/expect expressions, not executed or expanded parameterized test cases; expect static helpers can be included.

methodDetails.production: Full semantic reading of all 104 assigned non-test source, CSS, entrypoint, config, and verification-document files via bounded Get-Content outputs. Truncated spans were reread. Considered async owner/generation checks, UI confirmation invalidation, operation receipt identity and unknown outcomes, capability readiness, media and secret exposure, project/thread/lease transitions, resources and responsive layout.
methodDetails.tests: Parsed all selected test source into an AST with the locally installed rolldown parser. For the assigned first 28 test files, read all extracted test declarations (including parameter tables), expect expressions, hooks, complete top-level and local variable/function/class fixture declarations, and recursively traversed calls/effects. Supplemental AST extraction covered assignments, updates, throws, control conditions/loops, and standalone screen find/get implicit assertions. Full original test bodies are retained in extraction evidence; selected boundary/fixture code was reread directly. This is contract review, not a claim of manually reading every original test line.
